note: Glaze 1.0.37: themes now download from Cloudflare R2, and every theme has five different small artworks. The Widgets tab is simpler: no Medium and Large tabs, just your theme's Artwork 1-5 and Custom 1-5, straight away. After you change theme it updates by itself, showing a short Preparing step instead of the old theme's art. Theme packs you already downloaded update to the new artwork. Downloads are still checked file by file, and Glaze still collects no data.
